name: Short Cut Vegetarian Ramen with Egg, Baby Corn, Tomatoes & Chili Crunch

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor
chili crunch (spicy chili pepper condiment with crunchy bits)

instructions.primary_message: Place hot water (from the tap) in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Drain and cut baby corn into bite-sized pieces.

Once the water is boiling, add veggies and noodles. Stir to combine the soup and cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles and veggies are soft, 3-4 minutes. Remove soup from heat, add flavor packets, and stir until combined.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (3 oz) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, halve eggs lengthwise.
To serve, divide soup and eggs between bowls. Drizzle with chili crunch and enjoy!
